lead: `verify.py`'s `extension` leg failing with `"tsc" ... nicht gefunden` (tsc not found) is a missing `editors/vscode/node_modules`, not the change under test.
body: The directory is git-ignored, so nothing in the tree restores it once it is gone, and the leg runs whenever the Core registry moves. Run `npm ci --no-audit --no-fund` in `editors/vscode` (it reads the committed lockfile) and re-run `verify.py`.
